title: GCompris
pre: foreach($p in "$env:APPDATA\gcompris-qt","$env:LOCALAPPDATA\gcompris-qt","$env:APPDATA\KDE"){ New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $p | Out-Null; Set-Content -Encoding ascii "$p\GCompris.conf" "[General]`r`nlocale=ru_RU.UTF-8`r`nisFirstRun=false`r`n" }

New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\gcompris-qt" | Out-Null; Set-Content -Encoding ascii "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\gcompris-qt\GCompris.conf" "[General]`r`nlocale=ru_RU.UTF-8`r`nisFirstRun=false`r`n"; $m='C:\gc.msi'; Invoke-WebRequest -UserAgent 'Mozilla/5.0' -Uri https://download.kde.org/stable/gcompris/qt/windows/gcompris-qt-26.2-win64-gcc.msi -OutFile $m; Start-Process msiexec -ArgumentList '/i',$m,'/qn' -Wait; Test-Path 'C:\Program Files\GCompris-Qt\bin\GCompris.exe'
